# OnSite 310S Inc.

> Mobile pre-purchase used car inspections in Mississauga, Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (Ontario, Canada), done at the car's location by Nigel Devonish, a Red Seal 310S licensed automotive service technician. $200 CAD, HST included, with no travel fee. Same-day or next-day inspections and a same-day online report.

## Key facts

- Service: independent pre-purchase inspection (PPI) of used cars, SUVs and pickups, at the dealer lot or private seller's location. The buyer doesn't need to be there.
- Inspector: Nigel Devonish, owner. Red Seal 310S licensed automotive service technician; honours advanced diploma in Automotive Technology, Centennial College; trained at import and European dealerships. Every inspection is done by him.
- Price: $200 CAD, HST included. No travel fee within the service area. Pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna or Interac e-Transfer.
- Service area: Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Milton, Burlington, Hamilton, Toronto (Etobicoke, North York, Scarborough), Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham, Newmarket, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Barrie, Kitchener-Waterloo. Farther away by request.
- Hours: Sunday and Monday 8 AM to 9 PM; Tuesday to Saturday 3 PM to 9 PM (Eastern Time). Usually same day or next day.
- What's checked: Carfax Canada history matched against paint thickness readings on every panel (to find unreported accident repairs and body filler), full computer system scan for active and permanent fault codes, battery and charging system test, tire tread depth and DOT age on every tire, and a test drive.
- Report: same-day online report the buyer opens on their phone, plus a PDF. Includes a recommendation (Recommended, Recommended if fixed, or Not recommended), any major findings, topics to raise with the seller, the Carfax compared with the paint readings, scan and battery results, tire readings, photos, and the buyer's rights with an Ontario dealer (OMVIC).
- Recommends buying only with a Safety Standards Certificate and an extended warranty. Does not recommend as-is cars.
- Not a warranty or a safety certificate; it reports the car's condition on the day of the inspection.
